primary_source.name: Michigan Statewide NG911 GIS Repository — Site Structure Address Points
primary_source.agency: Michigan Department of Technology, Management and Budget; Michigan State Police 9-1-1 Administration
primary_source.authority_basis: Official statewide NG911 repository for PSAP-contributed site/structure address points; Michigan DTMB states the repository aggregates statewide NG911 GIS data and publishes metadata for the aggregated geodatabase.
primary_source.refresh: Contributor uploads recommended at least quarterly; no public snapshot/version was exposed in the reviewed official material.

rights.evidence: The official repository documentation describes controlled PSAP/repository downloads and contributor access, but does not grant an explicit unrestricted, public-domain, CC0, CC-BY, or commercial-reuse license for the statewide address-point export.
rights.attribution: Retain DTMB/MSP and contributing PSAP attribution if access and rights are later cleared.

technical.reason: No acquisition performed while dataset-specific reuse terms and a public statewide delivery path remain unresolved.
technical.generic_connector: ArcGIS/FGDB adapter can be reused once an authorized export or endpoint is supplied.
technical.identity_strategy: Use contributor/agency ID plus source record ID/UUID where present; finalize against actual schema.

county_local_failover.reason: Michigan has 83 county-maintained addressing authorities. The existing vault/source registry contains no complete county inventory or dataset-specific licenses; assembling a statewide county mosaic without those rights artifacts would be an unbounded source hunt and would risk unlicensed reuse.
county_local_failover.next_activation: For each registry-pinned county source with explicit permissive terms, run the existing generic ArcGIS/FGDB path and reconcile MI coverage against NAD.
